description: This file defines the 'Message' class within the Orleans.Runtime namespace, representing a message in the Orleans distributed runtime. It includes properties for message headers, identifiers, addresses, flags, and serialization details, as well as nested enums and structures for message direction, response types, rejection types, and packed header fields.

classes.name: Message
classes.description: Represents a network message in Orleans, encapsulating headers, addresses, flags, and payload information, with serialization support and internal state management.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the message object.

methods.name: TryFormat
methods.description: Attempts to format the message into a character span, providing a custom string representation.

methods.name: IsPing
methods.description: Determines if the message is a ping message based on request context data.

methods.name: AddToCacheInvalidationHeader
methods.description: Adds cache invalidation entries to the message's header.

methods.name: IsExpirableMessage
methods.description: Checks if the message is eligible for expiration based on its target and direction.

methods.name: SetTimeToLiveMilliseconds
methods.description: Sets the message's time-to-live in milliseconds.

methods.name: SetInfiniteTimeToLive
methods.description: Removes the expiration, setting the message to have infinite TTL.
